insights: The Lindstrom involution is self-inverse because the canonical shared point (minimum splitIdx) is preserved when paths are swapped at that point
splitIdx a p = p.1 + (p.2 - a) is the key deterministic index making the involution work
For shared points, splitIdx a2 p - splitIdx a1 p = a1 - a2 (constant), so preserving one index preserves the other
